placement.placementAuditNote: NIRF 2025 UG 4-year batch graduating 2023-24: 1,073 graduated, 75 to higher studies, 996 placed of 998 eligible. Median Rs 2,000,000. Headline CTC: AMBIGUITY: two official own-domain newsletters. Jan 2024 newsletter (alumni-newsletter-2024-jan.pdf, p.1 'Internship/Placement Updates') explicitly states for session 2023-24, as of 1 Feb 2024: 1044 offers incl. 11 international, 'highest offered CTC Rs. 1.68 crores' (168 LPA). Dec 2024 newsletter says 1.65 crore as of 30 Dec 2024 but does NOT tie it to a season (Dec 2024 is within the 2024-25 season, so likely different season). Lower official figure used per D-23 (165 LPA) although season attribution of the Dec figure is unclear; the only explicitly 2023-24-labelled figure is 168 LPA. CTC, not stated domestic/international, partial-season snapshot. Caller may prefer 168 LPA.
